serving: Lincoln Rd & Ocean Ave (NE corner) to platform for Manhattan-bound B/Q service and Franklin Shuttle
alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: Take a Bay Ridge-bound B16 bus to Caton Av/St. Pauls Pl. Proceed south along E 18 St for the Church Av B/Q station. For S, take a Manhattan-bound B or Q and transfer at Prospect Park.


If you are on the platform: Take a Manhattan-bound B or Q to Atlantic Av-Barclays Center and then transfer to a Brighton Beach-bound B or Coney Island-bound Q to Church Av. Exit the station and proceed north along E 18 St to Caton Av/St. Pauls Pl. Take a Lefferts Gardens-bound B16 bus to Ocean Av/Lincoln Rd.
